summary.key_theme: 華爾街分析師普遍看好 First Solar 的基本面與估值，並透過調升目標價與評級給予強勁支撐。

bullish.title: BMO Capital Upgrades First Solar to Outperform, Raises Price Target to $263
bullish.reason: BMO Capital 分析師 Ameet Thakkar 將評級從「市場表現」調升至「優於大盤」，顯示對公司未來成長潛力的信心增強。

bullish.title: Deutsche Bank Maintains Buy on First Solar, Raises Price Target to $299
bullish.reason: 德意志銀行分析師 Corinne Blanchard 維持「買進」評級並大幅調升目標價至 $299，反映對其市場競爭力的長期看好。

bullish.title: Argus Research Reiterates Buy on First Solar, Maintains $275 Price Target
bullish.reason: Argus Research 重申「買進」評級與 $275 目標價，持續肯定公司的財務穩健度。

bullish.title: First Solar (NASDAQ:FSLR) Stands Out as a Decent Value Stock with Strong Fundamentals
bullish.reason: 分析指出 FSLR 具備 14 倍本益比的估值優勢，且擁有強勁的利潤率與低負債結構，具備長期投資價值。

bullish.title: First Solar (NASDAQ:FSLR) Passes the Peter Lynch Growth-at-a-Reasonable-Price Screen
bullish.reason: 符合彼得林區的「合理價格成長股」策略，低 PEG 比率與零負債狀態顯示公司財務體質極佳。

bullish.title: Jim Cramer: 'Put This Stock Away, Give It to Your Kids'
bullish.reason: 知名財經主持人 Jim Cramer 將其列為適合長期持有的標的，增強了市場對該股的信心。

bullish.title: Trump's Solar Tariffs Could Spark The Next Intel-Style Government Deal
bullish.reason: 川普的太陽能關稅政策可能為 First Solar 帶來類似 Intel 的政府補貼或合作機會，具備潛在政策利多。

bullish.title: Why Are ENPH, FSLR, ARRY, SEDG Stocks Rising Overnight?
bullish.reason: 反映市場情緒轉佳，帶動太陽能板塊整體走揚，FSLR 作為龍頭股受惠於資金流入。

bearish.title: SolarEdge Jumps 8% as UBS Sees 40% Upside From New Inverter Import Curbs; Enphase and First Solar Drift Down
bearish.reason: 儘管太陽能板塊整體受惠，但部分報導指出 FSLR 股價出現小幅回調，顯示短期獲利了結賣壓。

neutral.title: First Solar upgraded, Celsius downgraded: Wall Street's top analyst calls
neutral.reason: 僅為市場分析師評級變動的彙整報導，無提供額外分析觀點。

neutral.title: Here Are Thursday’s Top Wall Street Analyst Research Calls
neutral.reason: 列出當日多檔股票的分析師報告，First Solar 僅為其中之一，未深入探討細節。
